candidateEvidence: EXT4-fs (sdb) mounted the Toybox filesystem read-write
The filesystem unmounted before any LxMiniInitMessageCreateInstanceResult

candidateFatalEvidence: No GuestLog BUG, oops, panic, or segfault was observed. The mount-only launch child closed its control socket after mounting and then unmounting the registered ext4 filesystem, before returning CreateInstanceResult.
recoveryEvidence: The registered Toybox ext4 filesystem mounted read-write

classification.basis: The candidate entered /init, established VSOCK, attached the registered distro VHDX, and mounted its ext4 filesystem. It did not return CreateInstanceResult or keep the control plane alive, so B4 and later gates are not supported. Independent stock recovery repeated B6-T.
